# Build + test dependencies for the CI test image (Dockerfile.ci-test).
#
# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the `make test-ci-local` Docker image: edit this
# file to add or remove a test dependency. scripts/test-ci-local.sh rebuilds
# the local image when this file changes (Docker layer cache).
#
# Installed with apt's default recommends, the same way the c-tests job on
# ubuntu-24.04 installs its packages, so the toolchain (gcc, gcov, lcov)
# matches CI.
#
# One package per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.

pkg-config
